title: Sheets API v4 client (Ktor) with unit tests
action: Per D2/D3 and approach.md Q1: implement a Sheets API v4 client in mobile/sheets-client's commonMain using Ktor client + kotlinx.serialization (add the needed Ktor dependencies to build.gradle.kts). Cover spreadsheets.values.get (read) and .append/.update (write -- append+update only, no delete, per the locked Q10 decision) against the REST v4 endpoints, with @Serializable request/response models. The client accepts an already-obtained OAuth access token as input -- it must not perform the OAuth dance itself (that is oauth-sheets-4's job). Write unit tests in commonTest using a mocked/fake Ktor HTTP engine (MockEngine) with fixed JSON fixtures -- no real network call and no real credentials needed to pass. Cover at minimum: a successful read, an empty-sheet read, a 401 (expired/revoked token) response, and a 403 (scope/consent mismatch) response, each surfacing as a distinct, catchable error type.

truths: A successful values.get call returns parsed rows from a fixture response
A 401 response surfaces as a distinct unauthorized/expired-token error, not a generic exception
A 403 response surfaces as a distinct scope/consent error, not a generic exception
An append/update call's outgoing request targets exactly the configured spreadsheet range (asserted against the MockEngine's captured request, per plan.md test matrix item 9)

artifacts.substantive: real Ktor-based implementation covering get/append/update, not a stub

key_links: SheetsClient's Ktor HttpClient and its ktor-client-* / kotlinx-serialization-json dependencies are declared in this cell's own edits to build.gradle.kts (oauth-sheets-1 leaves the module skeletal with no Ktor deps)
prohibitions: No real network calls inside the unit tests

trace.outcome: Implemented Sheets API v4 client (Ktor + kotlinx.serialization) in mobile/sheets-client commonMain: SheetsClient (get/append/update against spreadsheets.values REST endpoints, no delete), SheetsModels (ValueRange, Append/UpdateValuesResponse, GoogleApiErrorBody), and SheetsClientExceptions (SheetsUnauthorizedException/SheetsForbiddenException/SheetsApiException as distinct catchable types for 401/403/other). Added ktor-client-core/content-negotiation/serialization-kotlinx-json + kotlinx-serialization-json to build.gradle.kts commonMain, ktor-client-mock + kotlinx-coroutines-test to commonTest. 6 unit tests in commonTest/SheetsClientTest.kt against Ktor MockEngine (no real network/credentials): successful read, empty-sheet read, 401, 403, and append/update range-targeting via captured request URL -- all green.

deviations.description: Cell's verify command './gradlew test' referenced a task that does not exist in this Kotlin-Multiplatform (jvm-only) module -- the plugin only wires up 'jvmTest' and the aggregate 'allTests', confirmed via './gradlew tasks'. Added a thin 'test' task alias (dependsOn allTests) in mobile/sheets-client/build.gradle.kts so the recorded verify command is actually runnable, instead of substituting a different command or blocking on it.
